title: Storyseam prompt preset
description: One shareable pre-prompt for one section (camera, audio, ...). docs/spec.md section 14. Installed with `npx storyseam preset add <url or section/id>` into config.json presets.<section>; /render appends its prompt after the block's own.

section.description: Where it installs: config.json presets.<section>. One preset per section is in use.

position.description: Where the prompt goes: "before" opens every video prompt, ahead of the block's own text (a look every shot is made in); "after" follows it.

prompt.description: The line every video prompt carries. Words only: a preset never raises the resolution or changes the model.

fields.description: Human-readable parts of the setup (a camera's body, lens, movement).

settings.description: config.json values the preset sets, by dotted path. Only video.generate_audio is allowed.

swatch.description: How the presets page draws it when no sample still exists.

source.description: Written on install: the URL or catalogue id it came from.
